name: Morgan Stanley Direct Lending Fund
summary: Morgan Stanley Direct Lending Fund is a business development company. It is a Private Debt fund. The fund specializes in senior secured term loans, first lien senior secureds (including unitranche loans), floating rate loans and second-lien senior secured term loans. The fund specializes in mezzanine debt, joint venture, unsecured debt, equity investments, leveraged buyouts, acquisitions, debt refinancings, recapitalizations and other opportunistic asset purchases. The fund chiefly invests in riskier bonds, issued by middle-market companies or by private equity firms looking to finance their acquisitions.
